XEM.geometry_scope: Simplified XEM board, four holes, three mating markers and ten major package envelopes; not a complete module component census.

LDO.geometry_scope: Native-source LDO outline, 61 nominal component boxes and two complete-mate connector markers, freshly registered to current carrier J1/J2.

contact_registration.J19_number_mapping: Source1..12 -> carrier even2..24; source13..24 -> carrier odd1..23. Source pads 25-28 are mechanical solder anchors and are excluded from the 24 signal contacts.
contact_registration.scope: Opposing DP/DS solder tails have different transverse locations; their longitudinal rows align. This is not a terminal-contact or toleranced-housing fit measurement.

terminal_pad_registration: 74 LDO electrical contact rows checked; nominal connector origins and longitudinal rows align, with expected opposite-footprint solder-tail offsets recorded under LDO. Source contacts are not identical XY copper pads.
intentional_connector_envelope_overlap: Current carrier DF40 socket boxes and inherited LDO complete-mate markers overlap in nominal seating; boxes are abstract package markers, not production housing/terminal geometry.
qualification: Nominal reference assembly only; source CAD unchanged.

envelope_screen.scope: Slab/AABB screen of public nominal boxes only. Exact housings, terminals, standoffs, screws, fasteners, tolerance, bow and retention are not qualified.
envelope_screen.reverse_screen_scope: Nominal attachment-envelope AABBs versus the current rectangular carrier slab, including the five attachment connector markers.

manufacturer_nominal_heights.height_scope: Manufacturer nominal mating heights for named families; source model PCB thickness and generic package envelopes do not establish installed/toleranced fit.
